changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: No index covers the lease end of a conversation turn, so a lease renewal rewrites the row in place (a HOT update) and adds no entry to the turn's indexes. The lease reaper finds its turns by status.

rollback.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_mentor_turn_leased_until ON mentor_turn (leased_until) WHERE leased_until IS NOT NULL
